qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind reviews on the shared initial tree and independent fix rechecks found the original correctness and comprehensibility defects resolved. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports and reconciliation are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: EN exclusions are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received direct, one-sided exclusions, including 回–一度/もう一度; 度–場合/ケース/機会/一度/もう一度/今度; 始まり–始め/出発; 開始–出発; plus the other justified pairs recorded in exclusionsAddedBeyondEn. Android applies each declaration symmetrically. Broad overlaps such as 回–今度, 長期–時期/時代, and 関連–関する were declined after comparing the displayed labels and full senses; they do not justify adding a transitive or topic-based cluster.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 19 relative links across the 17 listed Markdown files at corresponding EN-linked positions; kanji/守.md contains three restored 守る links. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 26 selected 30 N3 word cards from the frozen source. The dependency closure added 会 to support 会合 and 会合 to support 集まり; the final batch is closed under the source quiz-exclusion edges.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped: 離す→放す; 雇う→kanji 雇; 集団→グループ; 陰→影; 防ぐ→kanji 防 and 避ける; 誤り→誤解; 鋭い→kanji 鋭, 賢い and 鈍い. Ten written kanji have no RU kanji card: 鋏, 鋭, 鍋, 鎖, 防, 陰, 障, 隠, 雇, 離.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional additions: reverse declarations for already guarded pairs (Android checks either side); links from baseline kanji pages where EN has only a plain-text mention; 回–今度 (a repetition counter versus a deictic current/next occasion); 長期–時期/時代 (long duration versus event timing or an era); 関連–関する (relation noun versus topic-related verb). These were not established as direct answer ambiguities. No reviewer finding remains open.
